title: Blood smp
description: blood smp plugin for servers that when you kill you get 1 blood point when you die you lose 1 blood point and if you reach 25 blood points you get dash ability to use it double shif fast to get lunged in the air For more info add _sushigod on discord
body:
How to use the plugin

To see how much blood points /blood

To get the blood sword after getting 75 blood points /bloodsword

To use dash ability double shift after getting 25 blood points

Getting 50 blood points will give perm strength 1

If you have 4- Blood points you will get permweakness the more you go lower the weaker you get

Any bug & Suggestiosn Add _sushigod on discord
